subject: general
question: Which of the following initiative-objective pairings is correctly matched as per Government of India schem
solution:
The correct answer is __**PM PRANAM - Fertilizer diversification**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **PM PRANAM** stands for **Prime Minister Programme for Restoration, Awareness, Nourishment and Amelioration of Mother Earth.**
 
• This initiative aims to **promote the balanced use of chemical fertilizers and encourage the adoption of sustainable agricultural practices.**
 
• The scheme incentivizes states and union territories to reduce the use of chemical fertilizers by providing them financial support for successful implementation.
 
• **Under PM PRANAM**, the central government offers monetary rewards to states that decrease their reliance on chemical fertilizers and embrace organic farming methods.
 
• The initiative aligns with India's larger goal of achieving **environmental sustainability in agriculture** and reducing soil degradation caused by excessive fertilizer usage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UDAN - Road Safety:**
 
 
• UDAN stands for **Ude Desh Ka Aam Nagrik**, a regional connectivity scheme launched by the Ministry of Civil Aviation.
 
• It aims to make air travel affordable and improve regional air connectivity across India.
 
• While UDAN has no direct relation to road safety, it supports infrastructure development for small airports and air travel accessibility.
 
• The objective of UDAN is to make flying a reality for the common citizen, not to improve road safety.
 
 
 
• **NBS - Airline Support:**
 
 
• **NBS** refers to the **Nutrient-Based Subsidy** scheme in the fertilizer sector, not airline support.
 
• It aims to promote balanced fertilization and improve the nutrient quality of soil by providing subsidies for various fertilizers based on their nutrient content.
 
• This scheme encourages farmers to adopt fertilizers that replenish soil nutrients effectively.
 
• There is no known connection between NBS and airline support.
 
 
 
• **NSWS - Social Welfare:**
 
 
• **NSWS** stands for the **National Single Window System**, which is a digital platform designed to simplify the business approval process in India.
 
• It aims to provide a single-window interface for entrepreneurs to access multiple government services and approvals related to setting up businesses.
 
• NSWS is not related to social welfare but focuses on improving ease of doing business in India.
 
 
 
• **Main Theme:**
 
 
• The question highlights various government schemes with specific objectives, aiming to test the candidate's understanding of their purpose and implementation.
 
• Each scheme has its own unique focus, ranging from agriculture, aviation, business facilitation, and environmental sustainability.
